implementation.transaction: server validates the live mod block handle and loaded chunk, inserts the real ItemStack into the requested buffer slot, then reduces/removes the vanilla dropped entity; zero confirms failure
implementation.components: moved by cloning the complete ItemStack into container insertion; remainder stays on the original entity
implementation.range: Original collection matches the router block AABB inflated by 6: item centers through 6.5 blocks on each axis collect; centers at 6.625 or 6.75 do not. Diagonal center offset 6.5 on each of two axes collects, distinguishing the box from a 6.5-radius sphere. Touching the inflated face is excluded by entity-box overlap.
implementation.priority: When two eligible drops are present, the first entity in the original world query wins even when the later entity is nearer; reversing spawn/query order reverses the winner. Horizon's server vector traversal matches the measured cases.
implementation.unload: With the buffer full, a drop leaves the active entity set while the source chunk is unloaded, reappears after reloading, and is collected once after space is freed. Pending requests remain transient and the server revalidates the live handle before mutation.
implementation.remaining_limit: Eligibility filters beyond the tested vanilla diamond and emerald Item entities, additional box faces/corners, and larger candidate sets remain unverified. Vacuum is not declared complete.
